text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking toward Tracen Academy with 
Chrono Genesis...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Trainer over there, hold on a 
second!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really saved me! I really wanted 
to go visit them in the hospital today.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all! T-To think Trainer 
Kashimoto caught a cold... I hope she's 
okay...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Nn... So? What's a good get-well gift from 
an adult's perspective?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
No food. She'll probably prepare her own 
anyway. ...And something that won't 
totally weird them out.
choice_data_list:
Well, you'll probably just sleep all the 
time, so...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"A book, huh? That might actually be nice 
for when I can't fall asleep."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
You're definitely not the type to play 
games, true. ...If it's a book, I'd like 
one I can use for work!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ? E-Even though you have a cold?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe that's why. Not being able to 
work actually ends up stressing them out 
instead, you know?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"When we went to the hot springs together 
before, she called it a 'bath break' and 
kept reading race books! ...So yeah, she's 
definitely our top candidate!"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Little Cocon! Look at this!"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Hey. I really want to decide this already, 
so take it seriously...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Wait, that ball is...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Haha! I knew it! That's the ball Trainer 
Kashimoto hit herself in the face with 
before, isn't it!?"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Well, when I was having a picnic in the 
park, this rolled right up to my feet. 
...So naturally, I threw it back, right? 
To the owner, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Kashimoto did too, but... How 
should I put it, her... way of throwing 
was kinda..."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
BAM onto the ground! SMACK to the face! 
Blood just drippin' from my nose... man. I 
really panicked back then~.
choice_data_list: I see... But a picnic sounds nice.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
It's to keep us both from overworking, 
though. ...Once I get over this cold, 
maybe we can plan it again.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, wait. Can we stop by here? I wanna 
buy some eyeshadow."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Wait, this is the store I came to with 
Trainer Kashimoto before! I wonder if they 
have that lipstick she picked out for me~.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Little Cocon and the others are 
on really great terms with Trainer 
Kashimoto, aren't they?
choice_data_list:
Right. You two seem to hang out together a 
lot.

Right. Looks like you hang out together a 
lot.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Everywhere we go, there are memories... I 
can really feel their bond of trust. We 
should also—)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...!?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't think of anywhere else besides 
the racetrack and the academy— N-No, no! 
That can't be true...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "That can't... be, I think. But..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ... —I can't stay like this, can I?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"To an Umamusume, a Trainer is someone 
truly special. Without Trainers, we could 
never weave the history of racing."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: A-At this rate...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I'm so glad we found something I'm 
happy with! Thanks a bunch, you two!
choice_data_list: I just picked out a book, that's all
I just picked out a book, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
That's enough. Well, we'll be taking our 
leave now.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Pl-Please tell them to take good 
care of themselves...!
choice_data_list: ...All right, shall we head home too?
...All right, shall we head back too?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ha, ha—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, not "yes"! If I go home like 
this, our bond won't deepen...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I have to... I have to say something...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list:
Is there anywhere else you'd like to stop 
by?
There's no need to rush, okay?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! That's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I'm... so sorry. Um...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-It completely slipped my mind...
choice_data_list: Really? Let me know if you remember, okay?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Who knew just asking someone to 
hang out could be this difficult...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I need to find an opening...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: U-Um, well. Uh... you see...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: …………T-Trainer, are you feeling all right?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "I-In that case, I'm glad...! Ehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh... Who knew just asking someone to 
hang out could be this difficult...)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I-I need to find an opening...
